brief.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
brief.text: Meridian survived the storm. On sol sixteen, your next qualification is a short rover traverse to the Kestrel outcrop. Bring back useful evidence, and bring both crew home.

spare.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
spare.text: The habitat power pack stays connected. A separate, charged rover spare is seated and secured.

checks.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
checks.text: Before departure, check the wheel pin, navigation camera, cargo latch, radio, and brakes. Report what you find before you clear each item.

ready.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
ready.text: Both suits are ready. Keep enough oxygen and battery for the return, plus a reserve for delays.

route.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
route.text: Compare the terrain along each route with the reserve you will need to get home. The shortest line may cost more than it saves.

departure.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
departure.text: Meridian, Rover Two is rolling with Amara aboard. We will call out changes and reassess the route as we go.

haze.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
haze.text: That haze is hiding the far markers. Use our heading and nearby landmarks, and slow down so we can stop within what we can see.

hazard.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
hazard.text: There is broken crust and fine soil across the planned approach. Stop on firm ground so we can inspect it before committing the rover.

slip.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
slip.text: The wheels are spinning without much progress. Release the throttle, inspect the ground, and retreat gently only if the way behind is clear.

detour.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
detour.text: The soft patch is marked in our log. We will take the firm perimeter and update our return estimate.

ridge.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
ridge.text: At the outcrop, photograph both rock units first. Then move closer to record their boundary with a scale in the image.

science.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
science.text: Dark rock below, pale layers above. Location and context are logged; the images alone do not establish how these rocks formed.

sample.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
sample.text: That loose fragment is optional. Collect it only if we can keep our planned home reserve; the photographs already preserve useful evidence.

return.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
return.text: Meridian, Rover Two is returning along the revised route. Our observations and remaining reserves are logged.

dock.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
dock.text: Rover stopped, parking brake set. Both crew are home at Meridian.

success.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
success.text: You changed the plan when the evidence changed, recorded useful science, and returned with a margin. That is a successful traverse.

abort.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
abort.text: Both crew are back safely. The expedition log will guide our next attempt. We can return for the unfinished science another day.

margin.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
margin.text: You are home, but below the planned reserve. Review where the extra time and energy went before the next departure.

suspended.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
suspended.text: The simulation is paused. Review the warning, then retry from your last safe checkpoint.
